description: This file declares functions, macros, and constants related to managing network device traffic data, including harvesting status, reporting periods, polling periods, TTL overrides, and IP table data management within a network management system.

methods.name: SetNDTHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Sets the harvesting status for network devices; input is a boolean indicating enabled or disabled.

methods.name: GetNDTHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Retrieves whether harvesting is enabled for network devices.

methods.name: SetNDTReportingPeriod
methods.description: Sets the time period (in seconds) for network device reporting.

methods.name: GetNDTReportingPeriod
methods.description: Gets the current reporting period for network devices.

methods.name: SetNDTPollingPeriod
methods.description: Sets the polling period (in seconds) for network device scans.

methods.name: GetNDTPollingPeriod
methods.description: Retrieves the current polling period for network devices.

methods.name: GetNDTReportingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Gets the default report period.

methods.name: SetNDTReportingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Sets the default reporting period.

methods.name: GetNDTPollingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Gets the default polling period.

methods.name: SetNDTPollingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Sets the default polling period.

methods.name: GetNDTOverrideTTLDefault
methods.description: Retrieves the default timeout value for accelerated scans.

methods.name: ValidateNDTPeriod
methods.description: Validates that a given period value falls within an acceptable range.

methods.name: SetNDTOverrideTTL
methods.description: Sets the TTL interval for network device scans.

methods.name: GetNDTOverrideTTL
methods.description: Gets the current TTL interval.

methods.name: ResetEBTables
methods.description: Resets Ethernet bridge tables.

methods.name: GetIPTableData
methods.description: Retrieves current IP table data.

methods.name: isvalueinarray_ndt
methods.description: Checks if a given value exists in an array of ULONG.

methods.name: add_to_list_ndt
methods.description: Adds an IP table line to an internal list.

methods.name: print_list_ndt
methods.description: Prints the current list of IP table entries.

methods.name: delete_list_ndt
methods.description: Deletes the entire IP table entry list.

methods.name: delete_partial_list_ndt
methods.description: Deletes a portion of the IP table list.
